name: Liona Rivers
source: Liona is born with wavy blonde hair and blue eyes because of the European royal blood that runs in her family. She is very smart, elegant, refined, and angelic. Established an emotional distance with Junjou by maintaining an unreadable smile. No matter what, she is always courteous. She can be found playing soccer at the sport field. Likes sweets, especially the handmade cakes of Cafe Sonore.
